status_note: Approved at Roc's gate 2026-08-04 with an amendment: dancing lights, and casting at the Festival Grounds on festival night shows the past casts of many years at once.
learn_source: Conversation in the Square — old spell-marks on the Lantern Arch come up, and the way a collector would find more of them
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on the Arch stone once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the lights are many, bright, and dance long; at baseline a few faint motes rise and gutter quickly. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: Small dancing lights rise where past casts struck and drift along the old spell-marks, then gutter out
no_effect — nothing has ever been cast here; no lights rise
State-dependent: recently magic-lit, a few lights dance at the firebox mouth; lit by hand or long cold, none rise

State-dependent on place and night: on festival night, the grounds fill with dancing lights far past what any one surface carries — the past casts of many years rise and dance at once; on any ordinary day, only the sparse traces of recent local casts rise and fade
No physical effect — the lights drift past the fur without attaching
receivers.reaction_kind: chases the drifting lights, paw-swipes as they gutter
delighted investigation — crowds in under the dancing lights and drags whoever is nearest to see
